title: We got flying cars before GTA 6
blurb: Tesla revealed a new Roadster on 15 October 2026; at the show the prototype hopped and flew short distances on cold-gas thrusters.
image_note: Actual frame of the flip from Tesla's official "Roadster Event" stream (channel Tesla, uploaded 2026-10-16, 3840x2160), cropped to remove the HUD and scaled to 1920x1080. The on-screen altitude read 25.2 ft. Time in the stream is about 11:05-11:10 (section downloads are keyframe-approximate; hwbusters says ~10:56). No pixels altered except crop and scale.
image_alt: The new Tesla Roadster upside down in mid-air, thrusters firing, as it flips over a Tesla Semi and two cars at its reveal on 15 October 2026
